EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier0.DisplayName: Manage app permission grants and app role assignments
EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier0.Description: Allows the app to manage permission grants for application permissions to any API (including Microsoft Graph) and application assignments for any app, without a signed-in user.
EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier0.Reason: Manage permission grants and app assignments for any app without signed-in user; direct role assignment control enabling full tenant takeover.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier0.DisplayName: Read and write all authentication method policies
EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier0.Description: Allows the app to read and write all authentication method policies for the tenant, without a signed-in user.
EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier0.Reason: Write access to authentication method policies allows resetting MFA and credential controls, enabling immediate full tenant compromise.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier1.DisplayName: Read and write API connectors for authentication flows
EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier1.Description: Allows the app to read, create and manage the API connectors used in user authentication flows, on behalf of the signed-in user.
EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier1.Reason: Manage API connectors in authentication flows, enabling modification of authentication which can lead to identity plane control.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier1.DisplayName: Read and write to all app catalogs
EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier1.Description: Allows the app to create, read, update, and delete apps in the app catalogs without a signed-in user.
EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier1.Reason: Create, update, delete apps in app catalog without signed-in user; can modify app registrations enabling privilege escalation.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier1.DisplayName: Read and write the trusted certificate authority configuration for applications
EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier1.Description: Allows the app to create, read, update and delete the trusted certificate authority configuration which can be used to restrict application certificates based on their issuing authority, on behalf of the signed-in user.
EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier1.Reason: Modify trusted certificate authority configuration; can impact app authentication and enable privilege escalation.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier1.DisplayName: Read and update all apps
EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier1.Description: Allows the app to read and update all apps in your organization, without a signed-in user.
EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier1.Reason: Read and update all apps without signed-in user; enables modification of app registrations leading to privilege escalation.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier1.DisplayName: Read and write all applications
EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier1.Description: Allows the app to create, read, update and delete applications and service principals on behalf of the signed-in user. Does not allow management of consent grants.
EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier1.Reason: Create, read, update, delete applications and service principals on behalf of user; enables role assignment and privilege escalation.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier1.DisplayName: Manage apps that this app creates or owns
EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier1.Description: Allows the app to create other applications, and fully manage those applications (read, update, update application secrets and delete), without a signed-in user.  It cannot update any apps that it is not an owner of.
EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier1.Reason: Manage owned applications including secrets; can escalate privileges via owned app registrations.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier1.DisplayName: Read and write all authentication context information
EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier1.Description: Allows the app to read and update all authentication context information in your organization on behalf of the signed-in user.
EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier1.Reason: Allows updating authentication context information, which can be leveraged to modify authentication policies and potentially bypass MFA, enabling a reliable path to tenant takeover.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier1.DisplayName: Manage Delegated Admin relationships with customers

EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier1.Reason: Can manage delegated admin relationships and role assignments, enabling a reliable path to tenant takeover.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier1.DisplayName: Manage all delegated permission grants
EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier1.Description: Allows the app to manage permission grants for delegated permissions exposed by any API (including Microsoft Graph), on behalf of the signed in user.
EntraID_APIPermissions_Tier1.Reason: Can manage delegated permission grants, enabling assignment of high privilege roles and tenant takeover.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read all authentication method policies for the tenant, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read your organization's B2BManagement policies
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read all your organization's B2BManagement policies without a signed in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read your organization's conditional access policies
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read your organization's conditional access policies, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read your organization's device configuration policies without a signed-in user. EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read your organization’s identity protection policy
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read your organization’s identity protection policy without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read consent and permission grant policies
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read policies related to consent and permission grants for applications, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write your organization's directory access review default policy
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write your organization's directory access review default policy without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write your organization's application configuration policies
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write your organization's application configuration policies, without a signed-in user.  This includes policies such as activityBasedTimeoutPolicy, claimsMappingPolicy, homeRealmDiscoveryPolicy, tokenIssuancePolicy  and tokenLifetimePolicy.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write authentication flow policies
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write all authentication flow policies for the tenant, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write all authentication method policies
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write all authentication method policies for the tenant, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write your organization's authorization policy
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write your organization's authorization policy without a signed in user. For example, authorization policies can control some of the permissions that the out-of-the-box user role has by default.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write your organization's B2BManagement policies
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write all your organization's B2BManagement policies without a signed in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write your organization's conditional access policies
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write your organization's conditional access policies, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write your organization's consent request policy
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write your organization's consent requests policy without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write your organization's cross tenant access policies
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write your organization's cross-tenant access policies and configuration for automatic user consent settings to suppress consent prompts for users of the other tenant on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write your organization's M365 cross tenant access capabilities
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write your organization's M365 cross tenant access capabilities without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write your organization's device configuration policies
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read and write your organization's device configuration policies without a signed-in user.  For example, device registration policy can limit initial provisioning controls using quota restrictions, additional authentication and authorization checks.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write your organization's external identities policy
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read and update the organization's external identities policy without a signed-in user.  For example, external identities policy controls if users invited to access resources in your organization via B2B collaboration or B2B direct connect are allowed to self-service leave.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write feature rollout policies
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write feature rollout policies without a signed-in user. Includes abilities to assign and remove users and groups to rollout of a specific feature.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write your organization's federated token validation policy
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read and update the organization's federated token validation policy without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write your organization’s identity protection policy
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write your organization’s identity protection policy without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Manage consent and permission grant policies
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to manage policies related to consent and permission grants for applications, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write your organization's security defaults policy
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write your organization's security defaults policy, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write your organization's trust framework policies
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write your organization's trust framework policies without a signed in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read presence information for all users
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read presence information of all users in the directory without a signed-in user. Presence information includes activity, availability, status note, calendar out-of-office message, timezone and location.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write presence information for all users
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read all presence information and write activity and availability of all users in the directory without a signed-in user. Presence information includes activity, availability, status note, calendar out-of-office message, time zone and location.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read printers
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read printers without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and update printers
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read and update printers without a signed-in user. Does not allow creating (registering) or deleting (unregistering) printers.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Perform advanced operations on print jobs
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to perform advanced operations like redirecting a print job to another printer without a signed-in user. Also allows the application to read and update the metadata of print jobs.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read print jobs
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read the metadata and document content of print jobs without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read basic information for print jobs
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read the metadata of print jobs without a signed-in user. Does not allow access to print job document content.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write print jobs
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read and update the metadata and document content of print jobs without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write basic information for print jobs
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read and update the metadata of print jobs without a signed-in user. Does not allow access to print job document content.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read tenant-wide print settings
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read tenant-wide print settings without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read, write and update print task definitions
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read and update print task definitions without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read Privileged Access (PIM) custom extensions for your organization, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write Privileged Access (PIM) custom extensions
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write Privileged Access (PIM) custom extensions for your organization, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read privileged access to Azure AD roles
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read time-based assignment and just-in-time elevation (including scheduled elevation) of Azure AD built-in and custom administrative roles in your organization, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read privileged access to Azure AD groups
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read time-based assignment and just-in-time elevation (including scheduled elevation) of Azure AD groups in your organization, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read privileged access to Azure resources
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read time-based assignment and just-in-time elevation of user privileges to audit Azure resources in your organization, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to request and manage time-based assignment and just-in-time elevation (including scheduled elevation) of Azure AD built-in and custom administrative roles in your organization, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to request and manage time-based assignment and just-in-time elevation (including scheduled elevation) of Azure AD groups in your organization, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read time-based assignment schedules for access to Azure AD groups, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read time-based assignment schedules for permission grants for application permissions to any API (including Microsoft Graph) and application assignments for any app, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read, create, and delete assignment schedules for access to Azure AD groups
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read, create, and delete time-based assignment schedules for access to Azure AD groups, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read, create, and delete assignment schedules for app permission grants and app role assignments
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read, create, and delete time-based assignment schedules for permission grants for application permissions to any API (including Microsoft Graph) and application assignments for any app, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Delete assignment schedules for access to Azure AD groups
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Delete time-based assignment schedules for access to Azure AD groups, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read eligibility schedules for access to Azure AD groups
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read time-based eligibility schedules for access to Azure AD groups, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read eligibility schedules for app permission grants and app role assignments
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read time-based eligibility schedules for permission grants for application permissions to any API (including Microsoft Graph) and application assignments for any app, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read, create, and delete eligibility schedules for access to Azure AD groups
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read, create, and delete time-based eligibility schedules for access to Azure AD groups, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read, create, and delete eligibility schedules for app permission grants and app role assignments
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read, create, and delete time-based eligibility schedules for permission grants for application permissions to any API (including Microsoft Graph) and application assignments for any app, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Delete eligibility schedules for access to Azure AD groups
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Delete time-based eligibility schedules for access to Azure AD groups, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read profile photo of a user or group

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to identify Purview data protection, compliance and governance policy scopes defined for all users across tenant.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Compute Purview policies for an individual user
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to identify Purview data protection, compliance and governance policy scopes defined for an individual user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and query your provisioning log activities, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write all certificate based authentication configurations
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read and write certificate-based authentication configuration such as all public key infrastructures (PKI) and certificate authorities (CA) configured for the organization, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read all Question and Answers
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows an app to read all question and answers, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read any data from Records Management, such as configuration, labels, and policies without the signed in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allow the application to create, update and delete any data from Records Management, such as configuration, labels, and policies without the signed in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows an app to read all service usage reports without a signed-in user.  Services that provide usage reports include Office 365 and Azure Active Directory.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read resource specific permissions granted on a chat

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read all eligible role assignments and role schedules for your company's directory
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read the eligible role-based access control (RBAC) assignments and schedules for your company's directory, without a signed-in user. This includes reading directory role templates, and directory roles.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read, update, and delete all eligible role assignments and schedules for your company's directory
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and manage the eligible role-based access control (RBAC) assignments and schedules for your company's directory, without a signed-in user. EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Delete all eligible role assignments of your company's directory
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Delete all eligible privileged role-based access control (RBAC) assignments of your company's directory, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read the role-based access control (RBAC) settings for your company's directory, without a signed-in user.  This includes reading directory role templates, directory roles and memberships.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read Exchange Online RBAC configuration

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write all Cloud PC RBAC settings
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and manage the Cloud PC role-based access control (RBAC) settings, without a signed-in user. This includes reading and managing Cloud PC role definitions and memberships.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read M365 Defender RBAC configuration
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read the role-based access control (RBAC) settings for your company's directory, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read, update, and delete policies for privileged role-based access control (RBAC) assignments of your company's directory, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read your company's places (conference rooms and room lists) for calendar events and other applications, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to manage organization places (conference rooms and room lists) for calendar events and other applications, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read all workplace devices

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write all workplace devices

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read your organization’s identity protection policy
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read your organization’s identity protection policy on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read consent and permission grant policies
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read policies related to consent and permission grants for applications, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write your organization's directory access review default policy
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write your organization's directory access review default policy on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write your organization's application configuration policies
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write your organization's application configuration policies on behalf of the signed-in user.  This includes policies such as activityBasedTimeoutPolicy, claimsMappingPolicy, homeRealmDiscoveryPolicy,  tokenIssuancePolicy and tokenLifetimePolicy.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write authentication flow policies
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write the authentication flow policies, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write authentication method policies
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write the authentication method policies, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write your organization's authorization policy
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write your organization's authorization policy on behalf of the signed-in user.  For example, authorization policies can control some of the permissions that the out-of-the-box user role has by default.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write your organization's B2BManagement policies
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write your organization's B2BManagement policies on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write your organization's conditional access policies
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write your organization's conditional access policies on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write consent request policy
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write your organization's consent requests policy on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write your organization's cross tenant access policies
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write your organization's cross-tenant access policies and configuration for automatic user consent settings to suppress consent prompts for users of the other tenant on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write your organization's M365 cross tenant access capabilities
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write your organization's M365 cross tenant access capabilities on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write your organization's device configuration policies
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write your organization's device configuration policies on behalf of the signed-in user.  For example, device registration policy can limit initial provisioning controls using quota restrictions, additional authentication and authorization checks.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write your organization's external identities policy
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read and update the organization's external identities policy on behalf of the signed-in user.  For example, external identities policy controls if users invited to access resources in your organization via B2B collaboration or B2B direct connect are allowed to self-service leave.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write your organization's feature rollout policies
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write your organization's feature rollout policies on behalf of the signed-in user. Includes abilities to assign and remove users and groups to rollout of a specific feature.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write your organization's federated token validation policy
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read and update the organization's federated token validation policy on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write your organization’s identity protection policy
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write your organization’s identity protection policy on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write your organization's mobility management policies
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write your organization's mobility management policies on behalf of the signed-in user.  For example, a mobility management policy can set the enrollment scope for a given mobility management application.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Manage consent and permission grant policies
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to manage policies related to consent and permission grants for applications, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write your organization's security defaults policy
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write your organization's security defaults policy on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write your organization's trust framework policies
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write your organization's trust framework policies on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write access to mailboxes via POP.
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to have the same access to mailboxes as the signed-in user via POP protocol.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read user's presence information
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read presence information on behalf of the signed-in user. Presence information includes activity, availability, status note, calendar out-of-office message, timezone and location.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read presence information of all users in your organization
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read presence information of all users in the directory on behalf of the signed-in user. Presence information includes activity, availability, status note, calendar out-of-office message, timezone and location.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write a user's presence information
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read the presence information and write activity and availability on behalf of the signed-in user. Presence information includes activity, availability, status note, calendar out-of-office message, timezone and location.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read print connectors
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read print connectors on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write print connectors
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read and write print connectors on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Register printers
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to create (register) printers on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Register, read, update, and unregister printers
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to create (register), read, update, and delete (unregister) printers on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read printers
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read printers on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and update printers
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read and update printers on behalf of the signed-in user. Does not allow creating (registering) or deleting (unregistering) printers.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read printer shares
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read printer shares on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read basic information about printer shares
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read basic information about printer shares on behalf of the signed-in user. Does not allow reading access control information.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write printer shares
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read and update printer shares on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Create print jobs
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to create print jobs on behalf of the signed-in user and upload document content to print jobs that the signed-in user created.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read user's print jobs
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read the metadata and document content of print jobs that the signed-in user created.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read print jobs
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read the metadata and document content of print jobs on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read basic information of user's print jobs
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read the metadata of print jobs that the signed-in user created. Does not allow access to print job document content.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read basic information of print jobs
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read the metadata of print jobs on behalf of the signed-in user. Does not allow access to print job document content.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write user's print jobs
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read and update the metadata and document content of print jobs that the signed-in user created.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write print jobs
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read and update the metadata and document content of print jobs on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write basic information of user's print jobs
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read and update the metadata of print jobs that the signed-in user created. Does not allow access to print job document content.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write basic information of print jobs
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read and update the metadata of print jobs on behalf of the signed-in user. Does not allow access to print job document content.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read tenant-wide print settings
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read tenant-wide print settings on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write tenant-wide print settings
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read and write tenant-wide print settings on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read Privileged Access (PIM) custom extensions
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read Privileged Access (PIM) custom extensions for your organization, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write Privileged Access (PIM) custom extensions
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write Privileged Access (PIM) custom extensions for your organization, without a signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read privileged access to Azure AD
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read time-based assignment and just-in-time elevation (including scheduled elevation) of Azure AD built-in and custom administrative roles, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read privileged access to Azure AD groups
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read time-based assignment and just-in-time elevation (including scheduled elevation) of Azure AD groups, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read privileged access to Azure resources
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read time-based assignment and just-in-time elevation of Azure resources (like your subscriptions, resource groups, storage, compute) on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write privileged access to Azure AD
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to request and manage just in time elevation (including scheduled elevation) of users to Azure AD built-in administrative roles, on behalf of signed-in users.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write privileged access to Azure AD groups
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to request and manage time-based assignment and just-in-time elevation (including scheduled elevation) of Azure AD groups, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write privileged access to Azure resources
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to request and manage time-based assignment and just-in-time elevation of user privileges to manage Azure resources (like subscriptions, resource groups, storage, compute) on behalf of the signed-in users.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read assignment schedules for access to Azure AD groups
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read time-based assignment schedules for access to Azure AD groups, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read assignment schedules for app permission grants and app role assignments
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read time-based assignment schedules for permission grants for application permissions to any API (including Microsoft Graph) and application assignments for any app, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read, create, and delete assignment schedules for access to Azure AD groups
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read, create, and delete time-based assignment schedules for access to Azure AD groups, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read, create, and delete assignment schedules for app permission grants and app role assignments
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read, create, and delete time-based assignment schedules for permission grants for application permissions to any API (including Microsoft Graph) and application assignments for any app, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Delete assignment schedules for access to Azure AD groups
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to delete time-based assignment schedules for access to Azure AD groups, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read eligibility schedules for access to Azure AD groups
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read time-based eligibility schedules for access to Azure AD groups, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read eligibility schedules for app permission grants and app role assignments
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read time-based eligibility schedules for permission grants for application permissions to any API (including Microsoft Graph) and application assignments for any app, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read, create, and delete eligibility schedules for access to Azure AD groups
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read, create, and delete time-based eligibility schedules for access to Azure AD groups, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read, create, and delete eligibility schedules for app permission grants and app role assignments
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read, create, and delete time-based eligibility schedules for permission grants for application permissions to any API (including Microsoft Graph) and application assignments for any app, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Delete eligibility schedules for access to Azure AD groups
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to delete time-based eligibility schedules for access to Azure AD groups, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: View users' basic profile
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to see your users' basic profile (e.g., name, picture, user name, email address)

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read profile photo of a user or group
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read all profile photos of users and groups, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write profile photo of a user or group
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write all profile photos of users and groups, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read all programs that user can access
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read programs and program controls that the signed-in user has access to in the organization.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Manage all programs that user can access
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read, update, delete and perform actions on programs and program controls that the signed-in user has access to in the organization.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Compute Purview policies at tenant scope
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to identify Purview data protection, compliance and governance policy scopes defined for all users across tenant.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Compute Purview policies for an individual user
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to identify Purview data protection, compliance and governance policy scopes defined for an individual user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read provisioning log data
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and query your provisioning log activities, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read certificate based authentication configurations
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read certificate-based authentication configuration such as all public key infrastructures (PKI) and certificate authorities (CA) configured for the organization, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write certificate based authentication configurations
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read  and write certificate-based authentication configuration such as all public key infrastructures (PKI) and certificate authorities (CA) configured for the organization, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read all Questions and Answers that the user can access.
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows an app to read all question and answer sets that the signed-in user can access.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Access real-time enriched data in a meeting
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to get direct access to real-time enriched data in a meeting, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read Records Management configuration, labels, and policies
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read any data from Records Management, such as configuration, labels, and policies on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write Records Management configuration, labels, and policies
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allow the application to create, update and delete any data from Records Management, such as configuration, labels, and policies on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read all usage reports
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows an app to read all service usage reports on behalf of the signed-in user.  Services that provide usage reports include Office 365 and Azure Active Directory.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read admin report settings
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read admin report settings, such as whether to display concealed information in reports, on behalf of the signed-in user

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write admin report settings
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and update admin report settings, such as whether to display concealed information in reports, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read resource specific permissions granted on a chat
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read the resource specific permissions granted on the chat, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read resource specific permissions granted on a team
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read the resource specific permissions granted on the team, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read resource specific permissions granted on a user account
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read the resource specific permissions granted on a user account, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read all identity risk prevention providers
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read your organization's risk prevention providers, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write all identity risk prevention providers
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write your organization's risk prevention providers, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read all active role assignments for your company's directory
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read the active role-based access control (RBAC) assignments for your company's directory, on behalf of the signed-in user. This includes reading directory role templates, and directory roles.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read, update, and delete all active role assignments for your company's directory
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and manage the active role-based access control (RBAC) assignments for your company's directory, on behalf of the signed-in user. This includes managing active directory role membership, and reading directory role templates, directory roles and active memberships.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Delete all active role assignments for your company's directory
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to delete the active role-based access control (RBAC) assignments for your company's directory, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read all eligible role assignments for your company's directory
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read the eligible role-based access control (RBAC) assignments for your company's directory, on behalf of the signed-in user. This includes reading directory role templates, and directory roles.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read, update, and delete  all eligible role assignments for your company's directory
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and manage the eligible role-based access control (RBAC) assignments for your company's directory, on behalf of the signed-in user. This includes managing eligible directory role membership, and reading directory role templates, directory roles and eligible memberships.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Delete all eligible role assignments for your company's directory
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to delete the eligible role-based access control (RBAC) assignments for your company's directory, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read role management data for all RBAC providers
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read the role-based access control (RBAC) settings for all RBAC providers, on behalf of the signed-in user.  This includes reading role definitions and role assignments.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read Cloud PC RBAC settings
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read the Cloud PC role-based access control (RBAC) settings, on behalf of the signed-in user.  This includes reading Cloud PC role definitions and role assignments.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read M365 Defender RBAC configuration
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read the role-based access control (RBAC) settings for your company's directory, on behalf of the signed-in user. This includes reading M365 Defender role definitions and role assignments.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read directory RBAC settings
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read the role-based access control (RBAC) settings for your company's directory, on behalf of the signed-in user.  This includes reading directory role templates, directory roles and memberships.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read Exchange Online RBAC configuration
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read the role-based access control (RBAC) settings for your organization's Exchange Online service, on behalf of the signed-in user. EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and manage the Cloud PC role-based access control (RBAC) settings, on behalf of the signed-in user. This includes reading and managing Cloud PC role definitions and role assignments.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read M365 Defender RBAC configuration
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read the role-based access control (RBAC) settings for your company's directory, on behalf of the signed-in user. This includes reading M365 Defender role definitions and role assignments.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write directory RBAC settings
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and manage the role-based access control (RBAC) settings for your company's directory, on behalf of the signed-in user. This includes instantiating directory roles and managing directory role membership, and reading directory role templates, directory roles and memberships.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write Exchange Online RBAC configuration
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and manage the role-based access control (RBAC) settings for your organization's Exchange Online service, on behalf of the signed-in user. EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Allow the Teams app to manage all tabs for a user
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows a Teams app to read, install, upgrade, and uninstall all tabs for the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Allow the Teams app to manage only its own tabs in chats
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows a Teams app to read, install, upgrade, and uninstall its own tabs in chats the signed-in user can access.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Allow the Teams app to manage only its own tabs in teams
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows a Teams app to read, install, upgrade, and uninstall its own tabs to teams the signed-in user can access.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Allow the Teams app to manage only its own tabs for a user
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows a Teams app to read, install, upgrade, and uninstall its own tabs for the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read Tenant-Acquired Telephone Number Details
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read your tenant's acquired telephone number details on behalf of the signed-in admin user. Acquired telephone numbers may include attributes related to assigned object, emergency location, network site, etc.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and Modify Tenant-Acquired Telephone Number Details
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and modify your tenant's acquired telephone number details on behalf of the signed-in admin user. Acquired telephone numbers may include attributes related to assigned object, emergency location, network site, etc.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read Teams user configurations
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read your tenant's user configurations on behalf of the signed-in admin user. User configuration may include attributes related to user, such as telephone number, assigned policies, etc.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read available Teams templates
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read the available Teams templates, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read organizational teamwork settings
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read the teamwork settings of the organization, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read Teams app settings
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read the Teams app settings on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write Teams app settings
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write the Teams app settings on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read Teams devices
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allow the app to read the management data for Teams devices on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write Teams devices
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allow the app to read and write the management data for Teams devices on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read your sections
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read the signed-in user's sections (folders) for organizing chats and channels in Teams.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write your sections
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write the signed-in user's sections (folders) for organizing chats and channels in Teams.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read tags in Teams
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read tags in Teams, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write tags in Teams
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write tags in Teams, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Update targeted messages belonging to the user
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the user to update group chat or channel targeted messages in Microsoft Teams.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read all of the possible Teams interactions between the user and other users
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read all of the possible Teams interactions between the signed-in user and other users

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read Tenant Governance invitations
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to list and read all Tenant Governance invitations on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read Tenant Governance policy templates
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to list and read all Tenant Governance policy templates on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write Tenant Governance policy templates
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to list, read, create, update, and delete Tenant Governance policy templates on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read related tenants

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read Tenant Governance relationships

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write Tenant Governance relationships

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read Tenant Governance requests

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write Tenant Governance requests
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to list, read, create, and update Tenant Governance requests on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read Tenant Governance settings
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the application to read Tenant Governance settings on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read term store data
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read the term store data that the signed-in user has access to. This includes all sets, groups and terms in the term store.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write term store data
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read or modify data that the signed-in user has access to. This includes all sets, groups and terms in the term store.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write threat assessment requests
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows an app to read your organization's threat assessment requests on behalf of the signed-in user. Also allows the app to create new requests to assess threats received by your organization on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Run hunting queries
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to run hunting queries, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read all threat indicators
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read all the indicators for your organization, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Manage threat indicators this app creates or owns
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to create threat indicators, and fully manage those threat indicators (read, update and delete), on behalf of the signed-in user.  It cannot update any threat indicators it does not own.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read all threat intelligence information
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read threat intelligence information, such as indicators, observations, and articles, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read threat submissions
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read the threat submissions and threat submission policies owned by the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read all threat submissions
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read your organization's threat submissions and threat submission policies on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write threat submissions
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read the threat submissions and threat submission policies owned by the signed-in user. Also allows the app to create new threat submissions on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write all threat submissions
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read your organization's threat submissions and threat submission policies on behalf of the signed-in user. Also allows the app to create new threat submissions on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write all threat submission policies
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read your organization's threat submission policies on behalf of the signed-in user. Also allows the app to create new threat submission policies on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read topic items
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read topics data on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write trust framework key set properties on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read unified group memberships as guest
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read basic unified group properties, memberships and owners of the group the signed-in guest is a member of.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Convert an external user to internal memeber user
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allow the app to convert an external user to an internal member user, on behalf of signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read all users' lifecycle information
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read the lifecycle information like employeeLeaveDateTime of users in your organization, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write all users' lifecycle information

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write secondary mail addresses for users

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and update the on-premises sync behavior of users
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and update the on-premises sync behavior of users on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write password profiles and reset user passwords
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write password profiles and reset passwords for all users, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write user mobile phone and business phones
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write the mobile phone and business phones for all users, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Delete and restore users
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to delete and restore all users, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to enable and disable users' accounts, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to export data (e.g. customer content or system-generated logs), associated with any user in your company, when the app is used by a privileged user (e.g. a Company Administrator).

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Invite guest users to the organization
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to invite guest users to the organization, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read the full set of profile properties, reports, and managers of other users in your organization, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read all users' basic profiles
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read a basic set of profile properties of other users in your organization on behalf of the signed-in user. This includes display name, first and last name, email address and photo.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write access to user profile
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read your profile. It also allows the app to update your profile information on your behalf.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.DisplayName: Read and write all users' full profiles
EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and write the full set of profile properties, reports, and managers of other users in your organization, on behalf of the signed-in user.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read and report the signed-in user's activity in the app.

EntraID_APIPermissions_Catalog.Description: Allows the app to read the signed-in user's authentication methods, including phone numbers and Authenticator app settings. This does not allow the app to see secret information like the signed-in user's passwords, or to sign-in  or otherwise use the signed-in user's authentication methods.

Azure_BuiltInRoles_Tier0.Name: Owner
Azure_BuiltInRoles_Tier0.Reason: Full access including ability to assign roles in Azure RBAC, enabling immediate full tenant compromise.

Azure_BuiltInRoles_Tier0.Name: User Access Administrator
Azure_BuiltInRoles_Tier0.Reason: Can manage user access to Azure resources including role assignments, enabling direct identity plane control.

Azure_BuiltInRoles_Tier0.Name: Role Based Access Control Administrator
Azure_BuiltInRoles_Tier0.Reason: Can assign and delete role assignments, enabling immediate full control over Azure RBAC and tenant identity plane.

Azure_BuiltInRoles_Tier1.Name: Azure Kubernetes Service RBAC Writer
Azure_BuiltInRoles_Tier1.Reason: Access to secrets and ability to run pods as any ServiceAccount enables privilege escalation to cluster admin.

Azure_BuiltInRoles_Tier1.Name: Security Admin
Azure_BuiltInRoles_Tier1.Reason: Can manage security policies and alerts, enabling reliable escalation to identity plane control via policy manipulation.

Azure_BuiltInRoles_Tier1.Name: Key Vault Data Access Administrator
Azure_BuiltInRoles_Tier1.Reason: Can manage role assignments for Key Vault roles, enabling a reliable path to elevate privileges and control identity plane.

Azure_BuiltInRoles_Tier1.Name: Virtual Machine Data Access Administrator (preview)
Azure_BuiltInRoles_Tier1.Reason: Can manage role assignments for VM Administrator and User Login roles, enabling a reliable privilege escalation path.

Azure_BuiltInRoles_Tier1.Name: Defender for Storage Scanner Operator
Azure_BuiltInRoles_Tier1.Reason: Includes roleAssignments write/delete permissions allowing potential role assignment escalation.

Azure_BuiltInRoles_Tier1.Name: Azure Red Hat OpenShift Federated Credential
Azure_BuiltInRoles_Tier1.Reason: Can create, update, and delete federated credentials on managed identities, enabling trust relationships that can be leveraged to escalate to tenant-wide access.

Azure_BuiltInRoles_Tier1.Name: Managed Identity Federated Identity Credential Contributor
